scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @tg/server" "npm run dev -w @tg/client"
scripts.play: npm run build -w @tg/client && concurrently -k -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run start -w @tg/server" "npm run preview -w @tg/client"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build -w @tg/client
scripts.online:dev: npm run build:online -w @tg/client && npm run dev -w @tg/worker
scripts.online:deploy: npm run typecheck && npm run build:online -w @tg/client && npm run deploy -w @tg/worker
